CineIsle native ASS subtitle renderer

This software is based in part on the work of the FreeType Team.
FreeType is used under the FreeType License (FTL), including the separately
licensed BDF, PCF, hash and gzip components described by its upstream notices.

Runtime source and license notices:
- libass: libass.txt (ISC)
- HarfBuzz: harfbuzz.txt (Old MIT)
- FreeType: freetype.txt, freetype_licenses.txt, freetype_bdf.txt,
  freetype_pcf.txt, freetype_zlib.txt (FTL and upstream component licenses)
- FriBidi: fribidi.txt (LGPL-2.1-or-later)
- Fontconfig: fontconfig.txt (upstream copyright and component notices)
- Expat: expat.txt (MIT)

Pinned source URLs, revisions and SHA256 fingerprints are recorded in
docs/native-ass-sources.json. scripts/prepare-native-ass.py builds static
PIC dependencies with the local OHOS SDK and retains the original source
archives and build receipts in the ignored .local/native-ass directory.
CineIsle is GPL-3.0-only. Preserve the upstream notices and provide complete
corresponding source, including the dependency archives and build scripts,
with binary redistributions under their applicable license terms.

System font files are read from platform-declared directories at runtime;
no system font files are bundled with CineIsle.
